'''Matti Ilmari Jutila''' (16 March 1943 – 7 March 2026) was a mathematician and a [[professor emeritus]] at the [[University of Turku]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.utu.fi/en/university/faculty-of-science-and-engineering/mathematics-and-statistics/research|title=Research of Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, and Statistics|publisher=University of Turku|department=Mathematics|access-date=2020-08-17}}</ref> He researched in the field of [[analytic number theory]].

==Education and career==
Jutila was born on 16 March 1943 in Vesilahti, Finland.<ref name="hsobit"/> He completed a doctorate at the University of Turku in 1970, with a dissertation related to Linnik's constant supervised by {{ill|Kustaa Inkeri|fi}}.<ref name="mgp">{{MathGenealogy|id=20498}}</ref>

Jutila's work has repeatedly succeeded in lowering the [[upper bound]] for [[Linnik's constant]].<ref>{{citation|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=1AP2CEGxTkgC&pg=PA22|pages=22–25|contribution=A4 The prime number race|title=Unsolved Problems in Number Theory|volume=1|series=Problem Books in Mathematics|first=Richard|last=Guy|authorlink=Richard K. Guy|edition=3rd|publisher=Springer Science & Business Media|year=2004|isbn=9780387208602}}</ref> He is the author of a [[monograph]], ''Lectures on a method in the theory of exponential sums'' (1987).<ref>Reviews of ''Lectures on a method in the theory of exponential sums'': [[Sidney Graham|S. W. Graham]] (1989), {{MR|0910497}}; Ekkehard Krätzel, {{zbl|0671.10031}}</ref> According to the ''Mathematics Genealogy Project'', he advised five PhD students, all at the University of Turku.<ref name="mgp"/> He was elected to membership in the [[Finnish Academy of Science and Letters]] in 1982.<ref>{{cite book|chapter=Finnish Members {{!}} 31 December 2023 | title=Yearbook 2023 | publisher=Finnish Academy of Science and Letters|url=https://acadsci.fi/en/academy-publications/year-book/year-book-2023/ | access-date=27 May 2026}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Jutila died on 7 March 2026.<ref name="hsobit">{{cite news|url=https://www.hs.fi/muistot/art-2000011998860.html | lang=fi | access-date=26 May 2026|title= Merkittävä matemaatikko: Matti Jutila 1943–2026 | trans-title= Notable Mathematician: Matti Jutila 1943–2026 | page=B 13 | newspaper=Helsingin Sanomat | last1= Metsänkylä | first1= Tauno | last2= Vuorinen| first2= Matti | last3= Jutila |first3= Ilkka | date=26 May 2026 }}</ref>
